name: @montaj/model-server
description: Python 3.12 GPU model server (thin pnpm/turbo wrapper around the .venv).

scripts.test: node scripts/py.mjs -m pytest -q && node scripts/py.mjs scripts/coverage_gate.py
scripts.lock: node scripts/py.mjs -m piptools compile --no-emit-index-url --strip-extras --extra asr --extra align --output-file requirements.lock pyproject.toml && node scripts/py.mjs -m piptools compile --no-emit-index-url --strip-extras --extra dev --extra asr --extra align --output-file requirements-dev.lock pyproject.toml && node scripts/py.mjs -m piptools compile --no-emit-index-url --strip-extras --extra asr --extra align --extra diarise --extra bake --extra runpod --output-file requirements-gpu.lock pyproject.toml
